name: COLONEL FANSHAWE
note: FANSHAWE IN THE STREET, waiting, pleased with himself; he calls the duel (Main Street's accost). Doc 57 F4: 'The first time Thad steps onto the street after T_ASSAY_RUN, Fanshawe is waiting with half the town and the judges' table on the boardwalk, Sowerby holding the pencil.' Cut from room-02 operations 1 and 2 by tools/art/room02-duel-cast.py and laid over Room 2's own street. Present for the visit the duel is called on (T_DUEL_CROWD), and gone the next time.
barksNote: The duel is spoken through the assay (content/assay/assay.json).

sprite.frameNote: 0 thumbs in his waistcoat, turned to Thad · 1 breath (derived) · 2 a hand held out · 3 the watch · 4 tipping his hat.
sprite.redrawn: Errata 101 T (Tyler, 2026-11-06: no table at Duel Three; the gathering composed as one picture). Drawn standing on magenta from the locked cast master by cast-unify operation 28 (reference/cast-unify-26.txt), turned toward the duel, cut with its own pixels and a clean edge; placed where the painted composition (cast-unify 27, art/staging/cast-unify/batch-25/edit-porch.png) stood him, feet on the boards or the street, drawn at the street's man there.
sprite.figureHeightNote: Crown to sole, his top hat excluded (tools/art/figure-height.py --hat).

walkToNote: Facing him across the street, as the master stood them.
